outlook.statement: Exhilarating win in electricity tariff case
All time high PBT and PAT

Persistent pressure on sugarcane availability due to below-par Southwest monsoon forecast for 2026, low water storage in Mettur reservoir, and decline in fresh cane planting since Feb 2026. Exceptional income from APTEL judgement unlikely to recur at same scale. Sugar prices may recover on demand-supply equilibrium but could be eclipsed by rising cane costs. Company focused on cost optimisation and operational excellence.

World sugar balance for 2025-26 turning to surplus after six deficit years; world prices expected to remain range-bound barring weather challenges. Domestic sugar consumption growth expected at 1.5-2.0% CAGR over next 5 years. Southwest monsoon forecast for 2026 below par; El Nino threat to cane crop in Maharashtra and Karnataka. TN sugar industry facing survival challenge due to water stress; needs State intervention. Company expects to combat headwinds on strength of strong liquidity, operational efficiencies, and financial standing.

The company pursues a policy of conservative capital structure that seeks to provide adequate capital to its business for growth and create sustainable stakeholder value. Low gearing levels empower the company to navigate cyclical stresses in business. The company funds its operations through internal accruals and lays emphasis on prepayment of debts during up-swing in business cycles.

Interest Rate risk: The plan exposes the Company to the risk of fall in interest rates. A fall in interest rates will result in an increase in the ultimate cost of providing above benefit and will thus result in an increase in the value of the liability.
Investment Risk: The probability or likelihood of occurrence of losses relative to the expected return on any particular investment.

Salary Escalation Risk: The present value of the defined benefit plan is calculated with the assumption of salary increase rate of plan participants in future, based on past experience. Deviation in the rate of increase of salary in future for plan participants from the rate of increase in salary used to determine the present value of obligation will have a bearing on the plan's liability.

Demographic Risk: The Company has used certain mortality and attrition assumptions in valuation of the liability. The Company is exposed to the risk of actual experience turning out adverse compared to the assumptions.
